item: A drain may not starve the walk: a 20 s bound on fetching texts, and the drain's progress in the status
status: shipped (fixture-verified; awaiting the operator's 72 h run)
summary: On the operator's 72 h run the stream was live and the walk on, yet drains read 0 and the walk, WARM and search index never started: they run after a drain and a drain fetched one request per touched page with no bound. The drain now has a 20 s fetch bound shared between the editions, starting edition rotating (deferred texts counted and fetched first by the next drain, changes still all recorded), the walk keeps 30% of the idle window while on, and the status carries wiki_lane.service.drain (stage, edition, running time, failures, last error).
